title: Reachy Mini: the $300 open source robot you can actually hack — Andres Marafioti, Hugging Face
talk_summary: A Hugging Face researcher presents Reachy Mini, a $300 open-source hackable robot, and describes the speech-to-speech stack behind its voice agent. The most transferable engineering content is his optimization of an open-source TTS model (streaming, static KV cache, CUDA graph capture) and his split of LLM inference from conversation nodes for load balancing.

takeaways.technique: Static KV cache + CUDA graph capture for inference speed
takeaways.what_they_do: Replaced a dynamic KV cache with a static one (more RAM upfront) so the model could be compiled and CUDA graph captures could eliminate per-step CPU-GPU coordination.
takeaways.evidence_quote: We changed that for a static KV cache. We used more RAM from the get-go, but that makes it faster.
takeaways.numbers: Real-time factor from 0.8 (slower than real time) to ~5.8x real time; time-to-first-audio from several seconds to a few milliseconds

takeaways.technique: Separate LLM inference pool from session/compute nodes
takeaways.what_they_do: They run the speech-to-speech pipeline nodes separately from the LLM inference endpoints and scale each independently, because per-node LLM load varies wildly with user behavior.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it really helps to save on resources if you have the LLM separated

takeaways.technique: Streaming generation to cut perceived latency
takeaways.what_they_do: Made the TTS model stream partial output instead of generating the whole clip before returning, so consumers get first audio immediately.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the model would generate the whole output before giving it to you. So, it wasn't streaming.
takeaways.numbers: Time to first audio reduced from several seconds to a few milliseconds

takeaways.technique: Measure end-to-end latency, not just model latency
takeaways.what_they_do: He notes infrastructure overhead (network, load balancing, queueing) can equal or exceed model time, so client-perceived latency must be measured holistically.
takeaways.evidence_quote: infrastructure times are just as much as just the model because the model is quite fast

takeaways.what_they_do: He generated a working robot app by giving the coding agent the repo and a plain-language goal in one shot.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I one shot it with Coqui TTS. I told it like, 'Hey, here's the repo for the robot. Here's what I want it to do. Make it.'
